description: Static code analysis tool (linter) and code formatter for Robot Framework
rules: Robocop is both a linter AND a formatter for Robot Framework (.robot and .resource) files; the formatter replaced the standalone 'robotidy' project.
Lint code with `robocop check` and format code with `robocop format`. `robocop list` shows rules/formatters and `robocop docs <name>` shows documentation.
Select rules or formatters with `--select` and configure them with `--configure <name>.<param>=<value>` (for example `--configure line-too-long.line_length=140`).
Configuration lives in pyproject.toml, robocop.toml, or robot.toml under [tool.robocop.lint] and [tool.robocop.format].
Rules have a name (kebab-case, e.g. `line-too-long`) and a rule id (category prefix + number, e.g. `LEN08`); both can be used with `--select`.
The full, always-current rule reference (ids, messages, parameters, examples) is in docs/rules_list.md.
For AI-generated Robot Framework code, extend the opinionated `robocop:minimal` ruleset for a less noisy baseline, e.g. `extends = ["robocop:minimal"]` under [tool.robocop.lint].
